title: Cell cycle regulation of the psoriasis associated gene CCHCR1 by transcription factor E2F1
authors: Ling YH; Chen Y; Leung KN; Chan KM; Liu WK
one_liner_zh: 该文研究转录因子E2F1对CCHCR1基因的细胞周期调控，涉及TF-DNA结合但仅用报告基因实验验证，无AI或物理模拟方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: The coiled-coil alpha-helical rod protein 1 (CCHCR1) was first identified as a candidate gene in psoriasis and has lately been associated with COVID-19 susceptibility. Located within P-bodies and centrosomes, its exact cellular role and transcriptional control remain largely unknown. Here, we showed that CCHCR1 shares a bidirectional promoter with its neighboring gene, TCF19 . This bidirectional promoter is activated by the G1/S-regulatory transcription factor E2F1, and both genes are co-induced during the G1/S transition of the cell cycle. A luciferase reporter assay suggests that the short intergenic sequence, only 287 bp in length, is sufficient for the G1/S induction of both genes, but the expression of CCHCR1 is further enhanced by the presence of exon 1 from both TCF19 and CCHCR1 . This research uncovers the transcriptional regulation of the CCHCR1 gene, offering new perspectives on its function. These findings contribute to the broader understanding of diseases associated with CCHCR1 and may serve as a foundational step for future research in these vital medical fields.
abstract_zh: 卷曲螺旋α螺旋杆蛋白1（CCHCR1）最初被确定为银屑病的候选基因，近期又与COVID-19易感性相关联。其定位于P小体和中心体，但其确切的细胞功能和转录调控仍 largely 未知。在此，我们表明CCHCR1与其邻近基因TCF19共享一个双向启动子。该双向启动子由G1/S期调控转录因子E2F1激活，且两个基因在细胞周期的G1/S转换期间共同被诱导。荧光素酶报告基因实验表明，仅287 bp长的短基因间序列足以诱导两个基因的G1/S期表达，但CCHCR1的表达因TCF19和CCHCR1外显子1的存在而进一步增强。本研究揭示了CCHCR1基因的转录调控机制，为其功能提供了新视角。这些发现有助于更广泛地理解与CCHCR1相关的疾病，并可能为这些重要医学领域的未来研究奠定基础。
